definitions.full: H1985. Hillel הִלֵּל proper name, masculine ( he hath praised ; compare Late Hebrew proper name הִלֵּל , Hillel ) father of a judge of Israel Judg 12:13 , 15 , called הַמִּרְעָתוֺנִי see מִּרְעָתוֺן .

occurrences.englishText: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.
Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
